title: ADR-0155 step 5: the rest of the census — storage refusal for the share-grant leaf, the analytics compilers, the explainer record pass
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvvVzM5KhCWkT5f45c

Filing gate: ④ an execution card of an accepted cross-layer ADR · Source: fleet (ADR-0155, accepted in PR #34735, merge 64ccf6b0, ruling 6942854600). Part of #33787. Step 2 (#35786) merged as d7c257e924 via PR #35839 (2026-11-20, 14:40 UTC); its close-out 7042346562 lists what this step carries.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：同 #33787。这是 ADR-0155 的第 5 步。
- 这一步做什么：把剩下会碰到"共享子查询叶子"的地方补齐：存储层对它的拒绝、分析引擎的两种编译路径、权限解释器的逐条记录判断。用户可见行为不变。
- 不做会怎样：切换后，仪表盘、分析查询和"为什么我看得到这条"的解释会出错或被拒。
- 要你做的：无。

## Why (business)
Inherits #33787. Dashboards, analytics and the access explainer read through the same sharing scope; each must handle the leaf before the switch, or those surfaces break or disagree with list views.

## Scope (ADR-0155 Execution plan, step 5, as ② is ruled)
- The storage rows' refusal for this brand (R1, behind R2).
- The analytics compilers: the native compiler compiles the leaf; the engine strategy's merge admits the brand. The native compiler's card part carries the recognition of D4's two classes and the decline to the engine strategy.
- The explainer's record pass (resolved at the record).
- Carry-forwards:
  - Settle whether `service-analytics/src/read-scope-sql.ts#compileScopedFilterToSql` is one of D4's two brand-naming callers, and reconcile D4's "no other caller admits it" with ② letting the native compiler compile the leaf.
  - Give `fixedReadLeafClassOf` a public face (objectql exports neither it nor `driverEvaluatesFixedReadLeaf`), so the native compiler asks the seam instead of restating it.
  - The array-form `in`/`nin` carrying a leaf still answers 400 from `parseFilterAST` (L2 N3, accepted deviation on step 2). Decide it here.
- ⛔ No boot refusal on this card.

## Reader
Seat `repo:objectstack#7`, a dedicated card thread (L program; area-lease 〈不入区〉). L1 by `L1-a`; contract (L2) review per `contract-review.md`. Governing text: `docs/adr/0155-sharing-scope-share-grants-lower-to-an-engine-internal-semi-join-leaf.md` (D1–D6, Execution plan). Carry-forward ledger: comment 7042346562 on #35786.

## Order
Steps 3, 4 and 5 each depend only on step 2 and may run in parallel. Step 6 is #33787 itself and lands last, after O8's census is recorded in its body. ⛔ No card up to step 5 refuses a boot (plan step 5).

## Dedupe
`"ADR-0155" is:issue` → #33787, #35571, #35786. No step-5 card exists.

Grade: p2, the grade of the card it unblocks (#33787, p2). Type: Task.
